title: Crimson Eclipse
author: Any-Gap-933
selftext:
I usually don't post those "Look what I made in 24 hour things" but opus 5.5 really delivered. I made a Vampire Survivor clone with my own spin on it, took me about 2 days with the first 24 hours on its own and then 24 hours of my own updates. Opus 5.5 also made the trailer.

Features:

* **8 heroes**, each with a signature weapon, a unique trait and their own Ultimate
* **20 weapons — including 4 melee weapons — that evolve into 20 devastating forms** — the recipe is shown right on the level-up card
* **16 passive items** to shape your build, plus Reroll, Skip, Banish and Seal to steer your luck
* **8 stages**, each with its own terrain, hazard, horde and final boss — from the Moonlit Forest to Castle Draculus
* **A dash with invulnerability** and a kill-charged **Ultimate** for every hero — skill matters
* **Co-op for up to 4 players**, on one couch or online, with revives for downed friends
* **Every treasure chest is a show**: slot-machine reels, a blast of coins, rare Lucky, Divine, Mimic and Overflowing chests, and something different bursts out every time (sometimes it's cats)
* Elites, Treasure Goblins, Cursed Shrine trials, Blood Moons, swarms and sandstorms
* **Nightmare tiers**, Endless mode, permanent Power-Ups and 51 achievements with visible progress
* Choose 15, 20 or 30-minute runs, skip chest animations, and Save & Quit mid-run
* Full controller support, rebindable controls, and options to tone down effects, shake and flashes
